title: Remote channels
subtitle: External messengers (Slack, Telegram, …) as remote chat interfaces to your engenty agents.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.subtitle: Each binding connects one messenger workspace or bot to this tenant.
bindings.empty: No bindings yet. A binding connects one messenger workspace or bot (e.g. a Slack workspace or a Telegram bot) to this tenant, so messages there reach your engenty agents.
bindings.deleteConfirmBody: Delete the binding "{{name}}"? Messages from this workspace/bot will no longer reach engenty.

identities.title: Linked identities
identities.subtitle: Messenger accounts that are linked to engenty users of this tenant.
identities.empty: No linked identities yet. When someone messages a bound channel for the first time, they get a pairing link to connect their messenger account to their engenty user.
identities.revokeConfirmBody: Revoke the link for "{{name}}"? They will have to pair again before chatting with engenty from that messenger account.

pair.title: Link messenger account
pair.subtitle: Connect your messenger account to your engenty account.
pair.loadError: Could not check the pairing code. Please try again.
pair.missingCode: No pairing code in the link. Open the exact link the bot sent you.
pair.unknownCode: This pairing code is unknown. Open the exact link the bot sent you, or request a new one.
pair.expired: This pairing link has expired. Message the bot again to get a fresh one.
pair.alreadyClaimed: This pairing link has already been used. If that wasn't you, ask an admin to revoke the identity under Settings → Remote channels.
pair.prompt: Link the {{platform}} account "{{name}}" to your engenty account? Messages you send there will then act as you.
pair.claimError: Linking failed. The code may have expired in the meantime — request a new link from the bot.
pair.successBody: Linked! You can go back to {{platform}} and continue chatting.
